title: Builder loads primary editor and preview
description: Verifies the resume builder page loads with the main editor and a live preview area available.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Verify the resume editor interface is displayed
Verify a live resume preview area is displayed

title: End-to-end editing updates live preview
description: Verifies core resume edits (title, template, accent color, sections, entries) reflect in the live preview.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Fill a new value into the resume title field
Select a resume template
Select a different accent color option
Reorder resume sections using the section reorder controls
Fill in personal information fields with valid values
Add an experience entry
Fill the experience entry fields with valid values
Add an education entry
Fill the education entry fields with valid values
Add skills and contact information with valid values
Verify the live preview updates to reflect the latest edits

title: Validation errors shown for incomplete or invalid required fields and clear after correction
description: Verifies invalid or incomplete required inputs trigger validation errors and errors clear after fixing inputs.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Fill required fields incompletely or with invalid values
Attempt to save or finalize the resume
Verify validation errors are visible and prevent saving or finalizing
Correct the inputs with valid values
Attempt to save or finalize the resume again
Verify validation errors are no longer visible

title: Add and remove an experience entry
description: Verifies the user can create and delete an experience entry and the editor updates accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Add an experience entry
Fill the experience entry fields with valid values
Remove the experience entry
Verify the removed experience entry is no longer displayed in the editor
Verify the live preview no longer shows the removed experience entry

title: Reordering sections changes order in preview
description: Verifies section reorder controls update the section order shown in the live preview.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Fill a unique value into a field inside one section to help identify it in preview
Reorder resume sections using the section reorder controls
Verify the live preview shows sections in the updated order

title: Template gallery loads and shows thumbnails
description: Verifies the template library page loads and displays a browsable set of template thumbnails.

steps.description: Navigate to /templates
Scroll through the template gallery
Verify template thumbnails are displayed

title: Select template from library and apply in builder
description: Verifies selecting a template in the library navigates to the builder and applies that template.

steps.description: Navigate to /templates
Select a template to use
Click the option to use the selected template in the builder
Verify the user lands on the resume builder
Verify the selected template is applied in the resume preview

title: Attempt template preview shows fallback on failure (if preview feature exists)
description: Verifies that if a template preview fails to load, the UI shows an error state or fallback thumbnail.

steps.description: Navigate to /templates
Attempt to preview a template
Verify either a template preview is displayed or a fallback/error state is shown for the preview

title: Import CV control is accessible from builder header
description: Verifies the builder provides an import entry point to start the resume import flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Click the import resume control in the builder header
Verify an import interface is displayed that allows selecting a resume file

title: Unsupported file type shows validation error
description: Verifies selecting an unsupported file type for import shows a file type validation error and guidance.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Click the import resume control in the builder header
Select an unsupported file type for import
Verify a file type validation error is visible with supported format guidance

title: Export page loads and export controls are available
description: Verifies the builder loads and the export options can be accessed from the UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Verify the resume editor and live preview are displayed
Scroll to the area containing export actions
Verify export controls for generating documents are displayed

title: Attempt PDF export and handle outcome without relying on download
description: Verifies initiating PDF export triggers an observable UI response without requiring file download verification.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Click PDF export button
Verify an export-in-progress indicator or disabled export state is visible
Verify the UI returns to an idle state for exporting (export can be triggered again)

title: Attempt Word export and handle outcome without relying on download
description: Verifies initiating Word export triggers an observable UI response without requiring file download verification.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Click Word export button
Verify an export-in-progress indicator or disabled export state is visible
Verify the UI returns to an idle state for exporting (export can be triggered again)

title: PDF export failure shows an error state and no success confirmation
description: Verifies the UI surfaces an error message when PDF export cannot be completed.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Click PDF export button
Wait for export to complete or fail
Verify an export error message is visible
Verify no success confirmation for export is visible

title: Word export failure shows an error state and no success confirmation
description: Verifies the UI surfaces an error message when Word export cannot be completed.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Click Word export button
Wait for export to complete or fail
Verify an export error message is visible
Verify no success confirmation for export is visible

title: Prevent duplicate PDF export submissions while export is in progress
description: Verifies the UI prevents repeated export requests by disabling or ignoring additional clicks during an in-progress export.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Click PDF export button
Click PDF export button again immediately
Verify only one export-in-progress indicator is shown
Verify export controls are disabled or otherwise prevent repeated submission during processing

title: Error state is recoverable by retrying PDF export
description: Verifies the user can retry exporting after an error and the UI transitions back into an export attempt state.

steps.description: Navigate to /builder
Click PDF export button
Wait for export to complete or fail
Click PDF export button again
Verify the export error message is cleared or replaced
Verify an export-in-progress indicator or disabled export state is visible
